description: A static PHP class 'ImportCacheFiles' used to manage cache file names, directories, and related operations for import functionality within SuiteCRM.

classes.name: ImportCacheFiles
classes.description: Static class providing methods and constants for managing import cache files, including generating filenames, ensuring directory writability, and cleaning cache files.

methods.name: getImportDir
methods.description: Returns the import directory path used for cache files.

methods.name: convertFileNameToUrl
methods.description: Converts a local import cache filename into a downloadable URL.

methods.name: _createFileName
methods.description: Generates a filename for a specified cache file type, incorporating user ID.

methods.name: ensureWritable
methods.description: Checks if all cache files and their directories are writable or can be created.

methods.name: getDuplicateFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename for duplicate data export.

methods.name: getDuplicateFileDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the filename for duplicate display data.

methods.name: getErrorFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename for error logs.

methods.name: getErrorRecordsFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename for error records.

methods.name: getErrorRecordsWithoutErrorFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename for error records without associated error logs.

methods.name: getStatusFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename for status cache.

methods.name: clearCacheFiles
methods.description: Deletes all CSV cache files within the import directory.
